lore.intro:
Medical isolation. The ward was sealed
from the inside. The seal is intact.
The ward is not empty.

terminals.text:
ISOLATION LOG
Day 1: patient stares at south wall.
Day 2: patient talks to south wall.
Day 3: patient answers.
Day 4: two voices. One patient.
Day 5: [no further entries]

PATHOLOGY
Subject recovered from ward.
All organs mirrored. Situs inversus totalis.
Subject's ID chip reads valid.
It is the chip of a crewman standing
guard outside.

ISOLATION WING — DISCHARGE NOTICE
The discharge bolt takes its handle from the
ward side. There is no handle on this side;
that is the design. The seal team carried the
ward handle in with them when they closed it.
Nobody has carried it back out.

GUARD LOG, WARD ENTRANCE
0600 — on post.
0600 — on post.
Same hand, same ink, two lines, no gap between
them. Whoever wrote it isn't answering the page.
Post considered staffed. Post considered.

ENVIRONMENTAL SYSTEMS LOG 8K02
Medical Ward 05-16 humidity adjusted
automatically to 45% RH Parameter shift
observed at cycle 241.8, prior to quarantine
activation Attending logged admission of
biological subject at cycle 241.9 Shift
matches recommended biocompatibility profile
for organic respiration No crew-mind units
require this profile; adjustment source
unclear Flagged as possible preset carryover
from prior contaminant event Scheduler
diagnostic returns nominal; filed under
auto-humidity calibration checks

ADMISSION CHART, WARD BED 1
Patient reports hearing own voice from an empty
bed. Attending's note: patient IS the only
occupant. Chart amended twice to reflect one (1)
patient, current census.
Census taken again at shift change: two (2) beds
occupied. Census not amended a third time.
Attending went off shift and did not return for
handoff.
